_meta.purpose: Source of truth for the dennisnickens.com apparel storefront. Product detail pages, the checkout endpoint, and the Printify webhook all read from this file.
_meta.variants_status_note: Seed fields (title, slug, description, hero_image, printify_product_id) were harvested from the existing store.html apparel cards. The variants array for each product is EMPTY on purpose. Run scripts/build-apparel-products-json.js with a valid PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN to fetch real variant ids, colors, sizes, and prices from Printify and fill them in. Until then the product pages render in a finalizing state with checkout disabled.
_meta.generated_by: risk-free prep phase, checkout and webhook intentionally not built yet (gated on task 107)

leading-the-pack-tee.title: Leading The Pack Tee
leading-the-pack-tee.tagline: I Will Return Leading The Pack
leading-the-pack-tee.description: They counted you out. God was not finished. The wolf does not beg to belong. It goes quiet, gets stronger, and comes back at the front of the pack. Wear this for the comeback God is already writing over your life. You will not return the same. You will return leading.

silence-the-noise-tee.title: Silence The Noise Tee
silence-the-noise-tee.description: God is still speaking. The problem was never His voice. It was the noise drowning it out. Silence the noise, get still, and the call you have been chasing finally gets clear. Wear the reminder to quiet the world and listen for the One who is leading you.

stepping-up-tee.title: Stepping Up Tee
stepping-up-tee.description: Some people wait to be picked. You were built to lead before anyone gave you permission. When the moment comes and everyone looks around, you are the one who steps up. Wear it for the days you carry the weight without being asked and let your example do the talking.

raising-kings-tee.title: Raising Kings Tee
raising-kings-tee.description: The world is comfortable raising boys who stay boys. You are raising kings. Men of faith and backbone who lead their homes, honor their word, and answer to God. Wear it proudly for the calling of shaping the next generation the right way.

unbroken-vows-tee.title: Unbroken Vows Tee
unbroken-vows-tee.description: Anybody can say I do. Few stay built when the season gets hard. Forever means forever, a covenant you keep on the days it costs you something. Wear it for the love that does not quit and the vow you intend to honor for life.

singlehood-tee.title: Singlehood Tee
singlehood-tee.description: This season is not a waiting room. It is where God builds you. Solo era, no apologies, the time to get whole before you get attached. Wear it as a reminder that pouring into yourself and your purpose right now is not selfish, it is wisdom.

doing-it-gods-way-tee.title: Doing It God's Way Tee
doing-it-gods-way-tee.tagline: Built On Faith, Proven By Results
doing-it-gods-way-tee.description: Everybody has an opinion until the results show up. Built on faith, proven by results. This is for the ones who do it God's way and let the outcome speak for itself. Wear it on the days you would rather show people than tell them.

i-am-tee.title: I AM Tee
i-am-tee.description: When Moses asked God who was sending him, the answer was I AM That I AM. That same name is meant to lead your life. When you let I AM go before you, your purpose stops hiding and starts moving. Wear it as a daily declaration of who leads you and where you are headed.

sr-logo-cap.title: SR Logo Cap
sr-logo-cap.description: What sits on your head leads the room. The SR crest is the mark of someone done apologizing for their faith and the life they are building. Put it on the days you want the world to read your wiring before you open your mouth. Premium structure, clean lines, the message stitched permanently up front. Walk in already speaking.

sr-logo-polo.title: SR Logo Polo
sr-logo-polo.description: Some statements land louder when they are quieter. The embroidered SR crest turns a premium polo into a calm declaration that your faith leads your work, your home, and the love you are building. Made for the rooms where serious things happen. Boardrooms, pulpits, family dinners that matter. The shirt matches the man who decided to live this on purpose.
